items.title: Satya Nadella has issued a shocking warning to companies using AI

items.tldr: BlizzardはOverwatch、Warcraft、Diabloの勢いを再構築したものの、開発者たちはXboxのさらなる人員削減に直面し、数ヶ月の不確実性に悩まされている。

items.title: CrashStealer macOS Malware Uses Notarized Dropper to Pass Gatekeeper Checks
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have flagged a new macOS information stealer called CrashStealer that's capable of harvesting sensitive data from compromised systems. items.title: Google and Microsoft Pull ModHeader With 1.6 Million Installs After Dormant Collector Found
items.description: Google and Microsoft have pulled ModHeader, a popular header-editing extension with roughly 1.6 million installs across Chrome and Edge, after researchers found a hidden browsing-history collector built into its official store version. items.title: GigaWiper Lets Threat Actors Choose Their Own Destructive Attack

items.title: CISA warns of actively exploited RCE flaws in Joomla extensions
items.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) is warning that attackers are exploiting vulnerabilities in the iCagenda and Balbooa Forms extensions for Joomla to achieve remote code execution through arbitrary file uploads. [...]

items.title: Lidl discloses online shop breach after service provider hack
items.description: German discount supermarket chain Lidl notified customers in Germany, Belgium, and the Netherlands that attackers stole their personal information in a breach at a service provider. [...]

items.tldr: TL;DR: 新しいMemGhost攻撃により、AIエージェントは1通のメールを通じてユーザーに関する誤った記憶を持つようになり、その後のセッションでの回答を操作される可能性がある。

items.title: UK charges suspects linked to Russian Coms call spoofing platform
items.description: UK authorities charged five people following a National Crime Agency (NCA) investigation into Russian Coms, a major caller ID spoofing platform used by criminals to make over 1.8 million scam calls. [...]

items.title: Forg365 PhaaS Targets Microsoft 365 with Device Code and AitM Session Theft
